meta.title: Northern Blocks — a community conference
meta.description: A two-day community conference as a poster: the name at display size over a stage picture, a yellow ticket sticker, a blue band of numbers, speaker cards, the schedule as a ruled timetable, the venue with a map, ticket cards, news and a form. Built from a gogh site definition with Unsplash pictures.
meta.author: jamiemarsland
